diagnosis.cause: PID namespace differs from mounted procfs; numeric namespace child PID addressed another process in procfs

repair.method: Child preexec writes create-only identity from actual proc/self stat PID+starttime with namespace PID+lease nonce; parent validates namespace PID and nonce; all live CPU reads require same proc PID+starttime

independent_runtime_review.details: Child /proc/self identity with starttime is bound to namespace Popen PID and lease nonce; every CPU sample checks proc PID+starttime; namespace group signals remain owned. Missing proc entry handles exit race; RLIMIT and worker internal guard retained.
